dimensions.assessment: Aimed broadly at small business concerns nationwide utilizing SBA online learning platforms and resource partners.
dimensions.evidence: educational resources and modules for small business concerns

dimensions.assessment: Provides informational and educational modules without mandating operational changes or providing direct financial grants.
dimensions.evidence: establish and maintain educational resources and modules for small business concerns

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits the authorization of any additional amounts to carry out the act.
dimensions.evidence: No additional amounts are authorized to carry out this Act

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Small Business Act to mandate the creation of specific AI educational modules and an advisory working group.
dimensions.evidence: amends the Small Business Act to help small business concerns critically evaluate artificial intelligence tools

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent agency responsibilities to maintain ongoing educational resources for small enterprises.
dimensions.evidence: establish the educational resources and modules required

missing_information: Specific operating budget absorbed by the SBA for creating these modules within existing funds
Estimated number of small businesses that will access the platform
importance_detail.rationale: The AI-WISE Act requires the Small Business Administration to create and maintain online educational resources regarding artificial intelligence tools for small businesses, assisted by an advisory working group. Because participation is voluntary and no new funds are authorized, the direct operational impact on businesses is limited.
